something ive noticed has become increasingly prevalent online is the idea that fictionalized depictions of dinosaurs are inherently better than ones informed by science it was first obvious with the way people complained about velociraptor being feathered when that started making the rounds in the 2010s but when we found more material of spinosaurus that started kicking into higher gear now ive seen multiple posts on this subreddit where people complain about accurate dinosaurs being less cool than real ones and people who say they like accurate dinosaurs more are essentially told they arent are evil and why no one should get them why evolution isnt real and why climate change isnt real in other words its a form of science denialism science denialism simply put is rejecting the scientific consensus and established evidence for reasons based on personal politics economics or most commonly ideology it manifests as deliberate cherrypicking of data to support conclusions logical fallacies conspiracy theories and unrealistic expectations of certainty at its core is the idea that what you personally want to believe is true is inherently superior to what the scientific method has determined is the most likely truth and that anyone who disagrees is a bad person and its your right to silence them in my personal opinion saying that jurassic parks abominations are better than real dinosaurs because theyre bigger or more venomous is science denialism it says that features explicitly made up by the filmmakers author make the animal better than their reallife counterparts this has made it increasingly impossible to talk about the real animals without people complaining that they arent as cool as they thought they were which from what ive seen serves to stymie scientific discussion of these animals by making people fear harassment you cant talk about these topics without fearing that some person is going to be so offended by reality not aligning to their biases that they might try to kill you for speaking up this is symptomatic of a wider more systemic rejection of science in the united states brought on by the culture of the reagan administration but i think that in terms of dinosaurs it has a more specific cause i personally believe that michael crichton in some way intended for jurassic park to make people stop trusting paleontologists to understand this conclusion lets look at the evidence crichton in life was a science denier believing in all sorts of pseudoscience he believed that psychic spoon bending was a real thing and that scientists refused to research it out of pride for one and refusing to acknowledge certain aspects of actual science he testified in front of congress that climate change wasnt a big deal and he believed that we should bring back ddt for killing mosquitoes despite the evidence of how ecologically devastating it was and in a lot of his writings he waxes nostalgic about how mysterious dinosaurs are and well never know so much about themin the 1990s when a surge in paleontology in china argentina mongolia were revolutionizing our understanding of dinosaurs why was he like this notice when i said crichton thought well never know a lot of things about jurassic park reread the actual book and notice how he has his selfinsert ian malcolm rant about how we arent meant to play god notice that all the dinosaurs die at the end of the book notice how most of crichtons novels end in the scientists dying taking this and crichtons personality into account leads to this hypothesis crichton wanted people fiction he didnt want science to progress because it had discovered that the things he wanted to believe were true werent true at all and his arrogance and he was an arrogant man in life couldnt take it and to make sure this happened he abused his celebrity as an author to convince people that he knew more than the scientists who spent their lives studying the material firsthand and it worked people are nostalgic for jurassic parks designs because of the emotions associated with seeing the movies so when someone points out that the real animal is different from jps portrayal they take it wonder why i care because science denial doesnt stay in one lane it spreads all sciences use the scientific method all sciences feed into each other deny science in one place and sooner or later it eastasia analytic teppo turkki on china presupposed coup attempt teppo turkki zhang youxia rumors of power struggle and the purge of the chinese general staff 612026 with reservations but with reason it can be assumed that there has been a serious power struggle in the top leadership of china not necessarily a classic open coup attempt but a real and from xi jinpings perspective an existential power struggle the chinese ministry of defense announced two days ago 2412026 that general zhang youxia will be put under investigation on suspicion of serious disciplinary and legal violations zhang served in the top leadership of the chinese armed forces as a confidant of president xi jinping he has been vice chairman of the central military commission cmc and a member of the politburo of the communist party of china ie one of the partys approximately 20 top leaders zhang is also known for his longstanding relationship with president xi their fathers were both veterans of the mao zedong era and zhang has known xi jinping since childhood zhang is slightly older than xi zhangs sudden and rapid decline amid allegations of corruption and serious misconduct has stunned chinese followers the situation has raised questions about chinas internal power struggle along with zhang general liu zhenli also a member of the cmc and chief of staff was placed under investigation on similar corruption charges zhangs case is part of a broader wave in which xi jinping has been purging the leadership of the chinese peoples army under the guise of an anticorruption campaign for years xi began a crackdown on corruption in the military leadership when he came to power in 2012 since 2023 several highranking officers have been dismissed or arrested for example in 2023 a major scandal broke out in chinas peoples liberation army rocket force plarf in which up to 70 officers were arrested in october 2025 xi dismissed eight generals on bribery charges including he weidong the second vice chairman of the cmc two defense ministers wei fenghe and li shangfu have also lost their positions and party memberships in the past couple of years due to corruption charges the central military commission which included six generals at the start of xis third term in 2022 has shrunk to just one army general besides xi himself zhang shengmin the head of the militarys disciplinary body the removal of zhang youxia means that xi has now effectively severed the backbone of the chinese militarys top leadership when decisions are made by one man surrounded by his own truth taiwan japan and the west must prepare for the fact that xi jinpings china may be both weaker organizationally and more dangerous politically chinas official interpretation of the zhang youxian and liu zhenli cases is unequivocal it is a ruthless crackdown on corruption and indiscipline in the military not a political power struggle the ministry of defense used the blanket term serious violations of discipline and law which in the chinese system covers both bribery and political disfavor the pla daily the militarys main mouthpiece went further the paper portrayed the cases as a victory in the fight against corruption accusing zhang and liu of betraying the trust of the party and military leadership violating the accountability system of the chairman of the central military commission and undermining the partys absolute leadership in the military the official wording suggests political disloyalty and undermining xi jinpings authority behind his back although the details of the investigation have not been disclosed chinese media have stressed the necessity of the purges and indirectly admitted that corruption is still deeprooted even among xis own appointees there have been cases of briberypurchased promotions such as the career advancement of former defense minister li shangfu with the support of zhang youxian as well as more extreme allegations made in the west which beijing has not confirmed zhang has been reported in some foreign sources including the wsj for leaking nuclear weapons information to the united states this claim should be viewed with great caution chinese state media now portray xi as a leader who is purging the military to save it from within and defines corrupt or politically unreliable generals as a national security risk in chinese political history control of the military has always been crucial and zhang was practically the only person with any real institutional ability to balance or challenge xi given his position according to many western analysts zhangs ouster is above all a sign of xi jinpings centralization of power as first vice chairman of the central military commission zhang was responsible for operations personnel and arms procurement in other words a concentration of power that made him a strategic risk to xi especially ahead of the 2027 party congress and possible arrangements for xis fourth term zhangs fall is particularly strategic because he was considered a longtime ally and even a personal friend of xi the purge has fueled speculation about deepseated contradictions the formation of cliques in the military and even an indirect threat to xis position and power more and more experts are interpreting the purge as a political preemptive strike rather than a corruption investigation this is also indicated by the official announcement of the violation of the military commission chairman responsibility system no evidence of a military coup attempt has been presented but xi jinpings reaction shows that he views the situation as an existential threat according to china analysts with zhang xi has removed the last possible obstacles in his path but the price is high the top leadership of the peoples army is today very onesided and loyalty to xi takes precedence over military professionalism experienced commanders have been replaced by cautious sympathizers this has created a climate of fear in chinas top elite where no one feels safe ironically since many of the generals who have been sidelined were xis own appointees the credibility of the party leadership is eroding in chinese domestic politics this marks a historic shift the concentration of power in the hands of one man in a way not seen since the time of mao zedong the purge of chinas top military leadership could mean that in the short term chinas foreign policy will become more cautious as xi focuses his energy on consolidating power internally and reorganizing the military according to press reports strategists in tokyo taipei and washington estimate that chinas military offensive will be more limited in the near future due to the plas internal problems the internal turmoil triggered by xi is weakening tanks and yoda ela canals farming was closely connected to nature seasons and community cooperation the land was treated as a living system not just a production tool sri lanka also has many traditional rice varieties such as pachchaperumal suwandel kuruluthuda madathawalu and kalu heenati these varieties are known for high nutritional value natural resistance to pests and diseases ability to grow with minimal external inputs suitability for organic and natural farming before chemical fertilizers farmers relied entirely on natural fertilizer methods including neem oil and neem leaves for pest control coconut husk straw and plant residues to improve soil structure and moisture retention animal manure and compost to enhance soil fertility herbal and spicebased solutions for pest management green manuring to restore soil nutrients these methods maintained soil health and stable crop production for centuries unfortunately many traditional farmers today are giving up these practices due to economic pressure changing agricultural laws lack of financial support and limited institutional backing modern systems often favor chemicalbased solutions leaving traditional and sustainable methods without enough support at a time when farmers worldwide face high fertilizer costs soil degradation and climate change i believe these traditional practices still offer valuable anyone else notice heat tracing systems quietly wasting energy over time ive been reading more about industrial heat tracing lately and one thing that stood out is how often systems technically work but still waste a surprising amount of energy in a lot of facilities heat tracing was installed years ago for freeze protection and then basically forgotten over time insulation degrades operating conditions change and trace cables keep running longer than originally designed nothing fails outright but energy use creeps up and freeze risks still show up in unexpected places what surprised me most is how often the issue isnt the heat trace cable itself but the insulation condition and how the system performs in real operating conditions vs the original design assumptions some facilities are starting to treat heat tracing more like rotating equipment meaning periodic audits instead of reactive fixes after freeze events or downtime makes sense especially for power plants and industrial sites in cold climates curious if others here have seen similar issues heat tracing systems that technically work but are inefficient freeze incidents despite installed tracing insulation being the real weak point i came across a detailed breakdown that explains how audits expose hidden energy loss in industrial heat tracing systems would be interested to hear how different facilities approach heat tracing maintenance auditdriven vs fixwhenitfails

navigating land use regulations a farmers guide to arkansas farmland agriculture in arkansas is more than just a way of life it is the backbone of the states economy culture and heritage with its fertile soil diverse climate and abundant natural resources arkansas is home to a variety of crops livestock and farming practices however navigating the complex landscape of land use regulations is crucial for farmers looking to maximize their productivity while complying with state and federal laws this article serves as a comprehensive guide for farmers in arkansas to understand and navigate land use regulations effectively understanding land use regulations land use regulations encompass various laws policies and guidelines that dictate how land can be used developed and conserved these regulations can come from local state and federal levels and they aim to balance agricultural activities with environmental protection urban development and social interests for arkansas farmers familiarizing themselves with these rules is essential not just for legal compliance but also for reaching sustainable farming goals types of regulations affecting arkansas farmers zoning laws zoning laws determine how land can be used within specific geographic areas they can designate areas for residential commercial agricultural and industrial use farmers in arkansas should consult their local zoning ordinances as these can affect whether they can expand their operations build new structures or change land use environmental regulations the arkansas department of environmental quality adeq oversees environmental regulations that impact farming practices especially regarding water quality air quality and waste management common regulations include compliance with the clean water act which mandates that farmers manage runoff and protect water bodies from pollutants building codes farmers intending to construct buildingsbe it barns storage facilities or processing plantsmust adhere to local building codes these codes ensure that structures are safe and built to withstand environmental conditions common to arkansas land conservation programs various state and federal programs encourage land conservation through specific regulations programs such as the conservation reserve program crp incentivize farmers to adopt practices that improve soil health and protect biodiversity pesticide and fertilizer regulations the arkansas state plant board regulates the use of pesticides and fertilizers to ensure they are applied safely and effectively farmers must be aware of permissible substances application rates and safety measures to protect themselves and the environment the arkansas farmland protection act one of the key pieces of legislation affecting farmland in arkansas is the farmland protection act this act aims to preserve agricultural land from conversion to nonagricultural uses thereby promoting sustainable agriculture and rural economies the farmland protection act provides several measures to protect farmland such as establishing agricultural easements that restrict land use to farming and related activities offering funding and incentives for landowners who commit to keeping their land available for agricultural purposes encouraging local governments to consider farmland preservation in their planning and zoning processes steps for farmers to navigate land use regulations for farmers seeking to understand and comply with land use regulations in arkansas a systematic approach can be beneficial here are essential steps to navigate these regulations effectively step 1 conduct a land use assessment start by evaluating your land to identify its current use potential uses and any existing zoning restrictions a land use assessment will help you pinpoint what regulations may apply to your farming practices consider how your intended use aligns with zoning classifications and state or federal regulations step 2 consult local authorities local governments play a significant role in regulating land use farmers should engage with their local planning and zoning office to learn about relevant regulations and permitting processes start with the following zoning officer understand local zoning laws and how they apply to your property planning commission discuss plans for land use changes expansions or new projects local agricultural extension office access resources and expertise on regulations affecting agriculture step 3 understand environmental regulations compliance with environmental regulations is crucial for sustainable farming farmers should familiarize themselves with the following water quality regulations review permits required for water usage and work to manage runoff effectively soil conservation practices incorporate practices that protect soil health and biodiversity such as crop rotation and cover cropping waste management ensure compliance with state regulations on hazardous waste management particularly relating to pesticides and livestock waste step 4 stay informed about changes in regulations regulations can change based on political social or environmental pressures to stay informed subscribe to newsletters from agricultural agencies local government bodies and advocacy organizations join local agricultural groups or associations that keep members updated about regulatory changes attend workshops conferences and webinars focused on agricultural policy and environmental considerations step 5 seek professional guidance consider hiring experts or consultants who specialize in land use regulations especially if you plan significant changes to your farming operations legal experts environmental consultants and agricultural advisors can provide valuable insights and help you navigate complex requirements step 6 take advantage of available resources numerous resources are available to assist arkansas farmers in understanding and navigating land use regulations arkansas cooperative extension service provides educational materials and guidance on agricultural practices including compliance with regulations farm service agency fsa offers assistance with federal programs that intersect with land use local conservation districts provide specialized knowledge about conservation practices and help farmers access funding for sustainable practices engage with neighbors to build a support network strong community ties can help strategize collective approaches to land use challenges and advocate for favorable policies agricultural best practices crop rotation this improves soil health and can help comply with regulations aimed at preserving soil quality practice integrated pest management ipm this reduces reliance on chemical pesticides and enhances compliance with environmental regulations establish riparian buffers creating vegetative buffers along waterways helps reduce runoff and improves compliance with water quality standards programs regularly attend training sessions on safety environmental practices and regulations to ensure ongoing compliance conclusion navigating land use regulations is a critical aspect of farming in how does humidity affect sheet comfort humidity can totally change how your sheets feel ive tried everything from cotton to linen to bamboo and the difference is huge depending on the moisture in the air when its super humid sheets can feel sticky and heavy cotton especially lower thread count stuff tends to absorb moisture from the air so you can wake up feeling damp even if you just got into bed linen actually handles humidity better because its breathable and lets air move through so it stays cooler and dries faster if it does get a bit wet on the flip side in dry air some sheets feel rougher than they do in normal conditions cotton can feel a little crisp or even scratchy if the humidity is too low while bamboo or sateen sheets stay soft also your sheets might wrinkle more depending on humidity which can make them feel less comfy even if theyre the same material honestly the biggest thing is picking a material that works for your climate humidity isnt something you can control unless youre cranking a dehumidifier or ac so having sheets that breathe well or wick moisture makes a massive difference linen and highquality cotton with a looser weave usually win for me they just handle both sticky summer nights and dry winter air way better than most budget sheets ive woken up soaked in cheap cotton before that stuff really shows humiditys effect learning how your sheets react is a game changer

tiny bird falcons called the american kestrel falco sparverius are helping keep the food supply safe on cherry farms their presence appears to lower the risk of foodborne illnesses from pathogens every spring raptors return to nesting sites across northern michigan the smallest of these birds of prey a falcon called the american kestrel falco sparverius flies through the regions many cherry orchards and spends its days hunting for even tinier creatures to eat this quest keeps the kestrels fed but it also benefits the regions cherry farmers fruit farmers have been working symbiotically with kestrels for decades adding nesting boxes and reaping the benefits of the birds eliminating the mice voles songbirds and other pests that wreak havoc by feeding on notyetharvested crops in addition to limiting the crop damage caused by hungry critters new research suggests kestrels also lower the risk of foodborne illnesses the study published in november in the journal of applied ecology suggests the kestrels help keep harmful pathogens off of fruit headed to consumers by eating and scaring off small birds that carry those pathogens orchards housing the birds in nest boxes saw fewer cherryeating birds than orchards without kestrels on site this translated to an 81 percent reduction in crop damagesuch as bite marks or missing fruitand a 66 percent decrease in branches contaminated with bird feces kestrels are not very expensive to bring into orchards but they work pretty well at deterring unwanted bird species said olivia smith lead study author and assistant professor of horticulture at michigan state university and people just like kestrels a lot so i think its an attractive strategy it may seem counterintuitive to solve a bird problem by bringing in more birds but kestrels are skilled hunters whose presence drives off songbirds afraid of being eaten habitat loss competition for food and climate change are leading to slow and steady population declines for the american kestrel losses of about 14 percent annually still these birds are abundant enough that in many areas of the continental united states all farmers need to do to attract them is add a nesting box to their land ive noticed a difference having the kestrels around hovering over the spring crops said brad thatcher a farmer based in washington state who has housed kestrels on april joy farm an organic fruit and vegetable farm for over 13 years theres very little fecal damage from small songbirds at that time of year versus the fall with farmers who already had kestrels on their land reporting fewer songbirds and less crop damage study authors hypothesized that food safety risks associated with pathogens birds carry may also be lower for farms harboring kestrels to test this the researchers evaluated 16 sweet cherry orchards in michigans leelanau and grand traverse counties the latter of which is considered the cherry capital of the world eight of the orchards studied had nesting boxes for kestrels and eight did not trying to get more birds of prey would be beneficial to farmers smith said if you have one predator versus a bunch of prey you have fewer birds overall if you have a lot fewer birds even if the ones that are there are carrying bacteria then you can reduce the transmission risk the studys findings that kestrels significantly reduce physical damage and food safety risks on michigan cherry farms demonstrate that managing crops and meeting conservation goalsby bolstering local kestrel populations and eliminating the need to clear wildlife habitat around agricultural areascan be done in tandem study authors say they recommend farmers facing pestmanagement issues consider building kestrel boxes which cost about 100 per box and require minimal maintenance

standing waves at civilizational scale humanity grace and the return of consequences if standing waves describe how individual lives take shape they also describe how civilizations rise stabilize and fall the same principles that govern a persons character govern a speciesonly on a larger circle with longer delays and far greater force when consequences return humanity is not exempt from resonance it is simply operating on a wavelength large enough to feel like freedom humanitys standing wave at any moment in history a civilization has a dominant standing wave a persistent pattern of values incentives assumptions and orientations that shape everything it does this standing wave is not a policy or a leader it is what feels normal for much of modern history humanitys standing wave has emphasized extraction over regeneration growth over balance speed over coherence domination over stewardship shortterm gain over longterm consequence these are not moral accusations they are descriptive patternsstable configurations that have proven efficient under certain conditions efficiency however is not wisdom ripples at scale technology industry expansion from this standing wave humanity has emitted enormous ripples industrialization fossil fuel combustion global trade mass agriculture digital acceleration artificial intelligence each ripple taken alone can be justified many have brought undeniable benefits longer lifespans reduced poverty unprecedented knowledge but ripples do not disappear they reflect and when ripples are large their reflections take time consequences are not external events ecological collapse climate instability mental health crises political polarization and systemic inequality are often discussed as separate problems in the standingwave framework they are not separate at all they are the same wave returning at different frequencies this is not punishment it is resonance a bounded system remembers what it has been doing grace why collapse takes so long one of the most confusing aspects of history is the delay between action and consequence why does damage accumulate without immediate collapse why does harm seem survivableuntil suddenly it isnt the answer is grace grace is not forgiveness grace is buffering in physical terms damping diffusion phase lag grace allows a system to continue operating despite accumulating distortion it spreads consequences across time and space granting freedom to explore experiment and even err humanity has received extraordinary grace a planet with deep ecological buffers fossil energy stored over millions of years oceans that absorb heat and waste social systems that delay reckoning grace made exploration possible grace also made denial tempting when grace turns dangerous grace becomes dangerous when delay is mistaken for exemption when feedback is postponed too long learning slows extraction accelerates and the system overcorrects later at that point collapse is not sudden catastrophe it is stored resonance releasing what feels like everything going wrong at once is often many delayed consequences phaselocking together overwhelming the systems capacity to buffer this is not moral judgment it is physics collapse as a standingwave transition collapse is often imagined as an ending in wave dynamics it is a mode shift when a standing wave becomes incoherent it destabilizes fragments or reorganizes into a new pattern this reorganization can be uneven painful destructive creative or all of the above collapse does not guarantee improvement it guarantees change what follows depends on what patterns survive the transition responsibility without martyrdom one of the great traps of awareness is believing that seeing the whole obligates carrying the whole it does not no individual is responsible for absorbing humanitys karmic return doing so does not reduce harm it only creates new casualties in this framework responsibility means something far more precise do not add unnecessary distortion to the field do not amplify incoherence through denial or despair maintain clarity where you are reduce harm locally increase coherence relationally this is not heroic work it is lawful work retuning the standing wave civilizations do not change because people panic harder they change when the standing wave shiftswhen what is rewarded normalized and admired changes this happens slowly through redesigned incentives cultural reorientation new definitions of success and the refusal to treat endless growth as sacred ripples follow standing waves not the other way around ethics after illusions fall once consequences are understood as resonance rather than punishment ethics becomes cleaner and less theatrical the central question is no longer who is to blame who deserves what it becomes what patterns are we reinforcing which standing waves allow richer experience to continue this is ethics without guilt responsibility without selfdestruction compassion without collapse humanity is being answered not condemned a single sentence captures the moment humanity is in humanity is not being punished it is being answered answered by the same field it has been shaping for centuries grace has not disappeared but it is no longer infinite the system is askingwithout wordswhether learning will occur before reorganization becomes unavoidable the larger perspective the standingwave model does not promise salvation it does not guarantee survival it does not assign villains what it offers is clarity and in a bounded universe of consciousness clarity is not consolationit is orientation civilizations that learn can retune those that do not still obey the same laws the ocean remains the waves continue what changes is whether the pattern high iq doesnt cause depression this lifestyle does okay so ive been obsessed with this topic lately because everyone online keeps romanticizing the whole high iq depression thing like its some badge of honor after diving deep into psychology research neuroscience podcasts and honestly way too many youtube videos on intelligence studies i need to call bs on this narrative the real issue isnt that smart people are inherently miserable its that many of us especially chronically online folks have built lifestyles that would make literally anyone depressed regardless of iq heres what actually happens youre smart enough to see patterns predict outcomes notice societal problems cool but then you use that brain to spend 12 hours a day doom scrolling isolating yourself because other people dont get it neglecting your body and convincing yourself that existential dread is just part of being intellectually aware thats not intelligence causing depression thats poor lifestyle choices wrapped in intellectual justification 1 intelligence gives you more tools youre choosing the wrong ones smart people arent depressed because they see reality clearly theyre depressed because they often use their intelligence to ruminate overthink and create elaborate mental prisons research from cambridge shows that high analytical thinking can absolutely lead to rumination but it can also lead to effective problem solving the difference how you direct that cognitive horsepower book rec here thinking fast and slow by daniel kahneman nobel prize winner in economics literally revolutionized how we understand human judgment this book breaks down how our brains process information and why smart people often trap themselves in analytical paralysis after reading this i realized i was using my smart brain to catastrophize instead of strategize insanely good read that will make you question every decision youve ever made 2 youre mistaking intellectual awareness for emotional intelligence being able to articulate why existence is meaningless doesnt make you wise it makes you a philosophy undergrad actual intelligence includes recognizing that meaning is constructed not discovered and getting on with building a life worth living anyway the huberman lab podcast has multiple episodes on this particularly around emotional regulation and cognition dr andrew huberman is a neuroscientist at stanford and he breaks down how cognitive ability and emotional regulation are separate systems you can be brilliant at abstract reasoning and absolutely terrible at managing your emotional state 3 depression correlates with isolation and smart people love isolating themselves heres the uncomfortable truth many intelligent people use their intellect as an excuse to avoid the messy uncomfortable work of maintaining relationships and community nobody understands me becomes a self fulfilling prophecy when youve decided in advance that socializing is beneath you studies from harvards longitudinal research on adult development literally 80 years of data show that the quality of relationships is the strongest predictor of happiness and health not iq not achievement relationships try the app meetup to find local groups around specific interests yeah it feels awkward at first do it anyway or reconnect with one person youve been avoiding because they wont get your vibe or whatever excuse youve created 4 your brain needs maintenance not just stimulation smart people often treat their bodies like inconvenient meat vehicles for their brains you optimize your information consumption but cant remember the last time you moved your body for 30 minutes straight the research is overwhelming here exercise has comparable effects to antidepressants for mild to moderate depression not because endorphins but because physical activity literally changes your brain chemistry promotes neuroplasticity and regulates stress hormones check out the youtube channel what ive learned specifically his videos on depression and lifestyle factors he synthesizes scientific research into digestible videos about how modern lifestyle mismatches with our biology create mental health issues his video on depression mechanisms changed how i view the whole intelligencedepression thing if you want a more structured way to internalize all this theres also befreed an ai learning app that pulls insights from psychology books research papers and expert interviews to create personalized audio content you can ask it to build a learning plan around something specific like managing rumination as an overthinker and itll generate podcasts tailored to your depth preference from quick 10minute overviews to 40minute deep dives with examples it also has this virtual coach called freedia that you can chat with about your specific struggles the voice options are surprisingly addictive theres even a sarcastic narrator if youre into that makes the whole learning process way less dry than just reading articles 5 youre consuming information about problems without taking action on solutions being aware of climate change political dysfunction economic inequality whatever without any meaningful action just marinates your brain in helplessness this isnt noble awareness its just self harm with extra steps the subtle art of not giving a fck by mark manson bestseller that actually deserves the hype manson is a blogger turned author who gets human psychology on a visceral level this book isnt just edgy self help its about choosing where to direct your limited mental resources reading this helped me realize i was spending cognitive energy on things i literally cannot control while ignoring things i absolutely can 6 intelligence without purpose is just expensive mental furniture your brain can analyze predict and understand complex systems great what are you building with that if the answer is nothing i just think about stuff then yeah youre probably going to be miserable purpose doesnt have to be grandiose it can be teaching one person something valuable building a small business creating art raising kids well but it has to be something often moderated by other factors like socioeconomic status social support and lifestyle when you control for things like physical activity sleep and social connection the smart people are sad effect largely disappears what actually predicts depression sedentary lifestyle poor sleep social isolation lack of purpose rumination perfectionism all things that smart people are perfectly capable of avoiding but often dont because theyre too busy being smart about the wrong things so no being smart isnt making you depressed your choices are the good news youre supposedly smart enough to figure out different choices start with one thing move your body daily reach out to one person build something small stop using your intelligence as an excuse for neglecting the basics of human wellbeing
